race.title: RHN Travel Norton's Coin Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: GALWAY REEL looks set to make it 3-3 since joining the excellent Olly Murphy stable. The main danger could be Impatient , who won this corresponding race in 2023 and went close off this mark last season. GALWAY REEL (IRE) IMPATIENT (FR) SOLAR SYSTEM (FR)
